property_summary: For every deposit at any time, the stored unlockTime must never be less than the current block.timestamp (it is clamped to max(_unlockTime, now)); the buggy version stores a past _unlockTime verbatim, breaking this rule whenever _unlockTime < block.timestamp.
change_summary: Replace the min() logic so acc.unlockTime is always set to _unlockTime, even if it is in the past.
